# Alif Laam Meem Academy

> Online Quran academy (Alif Laam Meem Islamic Institute) offering live 1-on-1 classes for children and adults worldwide: Noorani Qaida, Tajweed, Hifz memorization, Arabic, Islamic Studies for kids, and Tafsir. Certified male and female tutors. Flexible scheduling. Book a free trial on the website; no credit card required.

Contact: +92 300 6873200, infoaliflaameem@gmail.com. WhatsApp: https://wa.me/93006873200

## Courses

- [Noorani Qaida for Beginners](https://aliflaammeeminstitute.online/course/noorani-qaida): The foundation of Quran reading. Perfect for children and adults starting from scratch.
- [Quran with Tajweed](https://aliflaammeeminstitute.online/course/quran-tajweed): Learn to recite the Quran with beautiful melody and perfect grammatical accuracy.
- [Hifz (Quran Memorization)](https://aliflaammeeminstitute.online/course/hifz-memorization): Structured program to help you memorize the Holy Quran with proper revision techniques.
- [Arabic for Communication](https://aliflaammeeminstitute.online/course/arabic-communication): Master Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) for daily conversation and understanding Quranic text.
- [Islamic Studies for Kids](https://aliflaammeeminstitute.online/course/islamic-studies-kids): Comprehensive curriculum covering Seerah, Akhlaq, Fiqh, and Islamic History for children.
- [Tafsir & Quranic Meaning](https://aliflaammeeminstitute.online/course/tafsir-meaning): Deep dive into the context, history, and spiritual depth of the Quranic verses.
